name: rummagedeep-monorepo
description: RummageDeep — AI4Context. Deep search in pasted text and pages (PWA + extension).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @rummagedeep/core && npm run build -w @rummagedeep/pwa && npm run build -w @rummagedeep/extension
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @rummagedeep/core && npm run lint -w @rummagedeep/pwa
